plan: [ This is a sealed-bid second-price (Vickrey) auction with three bidders. The weakly dominant strategy is to bid my true value to maximize expected profit, independent of others’ strategies or history. Bidding below my value risks losing profitable wins; bidding above risks negative profit if I win and pay above my value. For a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values and 3 bidders, the weakly dominant strategy is to bid your true value. Overbidding risks winning when the price exceeds my value; underbidding risks losing when winning would be profitable. Values redraw each round and there’s no exploitable history in this single round. My value is 37, a valid 0.1-increment. Therefore, to maximize expected profit this round (and in the long run), I bid exactly my value.
